index.title: Automate Content Sharing
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Content Sharing. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Content Sharing. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job,
index.what_happened_excerpt: The user connected an email account and a document sharing service to automate content requests based on incoming emails. This is the public pattern for sharing content automatically.
